Hello {{name}},

Your code is {{code}}. It works for {{minutes}} minutes.

password_reset.body:
Hello {{name}},

Use the code {{code}} to choose a new password. It works for {{minutes}} minutes.

If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.
